Scenarios.Name: Sign-in
Scenarios.Description: You may not be able to sign-in to your XBOX profile, may be disconnected while signed in, or have other related problems. Features that require sign-in like most games, apps and social activity won't be available.

Scenarios.Name: Signing in to multiple devices
Scenarios.Description: You may not be able to sign in to XBOX on multiple devices (including PCs and mobile apps) at the same time.

Scenarios.Name: Creating profiles
Scenarios.Description: You may have trouble creating a new XBOX profile right now.

Scenarios.Name: Updating profiles
Scenarios.Description: You may experience problems updating your Microsoft account or XBOX profile, such as adding a new gamerpic or changing your account details.

Scenarios.Name: Account migration
